```plato

// A straight bounded span in space, directed from A to B. The point at parameter
// t in [0, 1] is A + (B - A) * t. Degenerate when A equals B.
type Line3D
    implements IGeometry3D, IOpenShape, IConnected, IBounded3D, ILength, IPointSet3D, ICentroid3D, INearestPoint3D, IDeformable3D
{
    A: Point3D;
    B: Point3D;
}
```
